notes.title: New Major Update
notes.content:
Extensive work has been done on game optimization, and DLSS technology has been added.
Significant improvement in image quality (approximately 50%).
Frame rate has roughly doubled.
Many bugs and major issues have also been fixed in the combat system, enemy AI, visuals, and much more.

notes.title: The first small update.
notes.content:
Minor optimizations have been made to the game, resulting in a performance boost of approximately 8-10 FPS, depending on the PC hardware.
Fixed a camera bug that caused it to fall below the surface.
Fixed a texture loading issue in cutscenes.
Adjusted certain aspects of the combat system, making animations smoother.
Corrected some dialogue errors.

P.S.: Work on fixes is still ongoing...
